features.name: cost_composite
features.description: Normalized average of buying price and maintenance cost indices (higher = more expensive overall).
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a smooth linear cost severity axis useful for margin separation between affordable and expensive cars.

features.name: capacity_composite
features.description: Normalized average of person capacity and luggage boot size (higher = more spacious).
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth continuous spaciousness measure helpful for linear projection toward usable cars.

features.name: safety_normalized
features.description: Safety rating scaled to [0,1] for direct linear weighting.
features.expected_model_benefit: Safety is a dominant acceptability factor; normalized scale aids SVM margin scaling.

features.name: low_safety_penalty
features.description: Continuous penalty for low safety (1 when safety=0, 0 when safety=2).
features.expected_model_benefit: Linear penalty term directly aligned with unacceptable cars in linear SVM decision boundary.

features.name: low_capacity_penalty
features.description: Penalty for cars carrying few persons (1 if persons=0, 0 if persons=2).
features.expected_model_benefit: Two-person cars are typically unacceptable; this provides a direct linear severity signal.

features.name: critical_deficiency_flag
features.description: Smooth indicator combining low safety OR low persons capacity (max of two penalties).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures critical disqualifiers that strongly push linear SVM toward rejection region.

features.name: value_for_money
features.description: Quality-to-cost ratio: capacity and safety divided by cost composite (smoothed).
features.expected_model_benefit: Ratio of desirable to undesirable attributes, providing a linear-discriminative composite.

features.name: overall_quality_score
features.description: Weighted linear composite favoring safety and capacity, penalizing cost.
features.expected_model_benefit: Approximates the linear acceptability score directly, aligning with SVM hyperplane geometry.

features.name: cost_safety_interaction
features.description: Interaction term: high cost combined with low safety produces large value.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures non-additive disqualification: expensive AND unsafe cars are strongly unacceptable.

features.name: doors_normalized
features.description: Doors count scaled to [0,1] for linear weighting.
features.expected_model_benefit: Mildly informative continuous attribute; useful as a weak linear contributor.

features.name: cost_capacity_imbalance
features.description: Absolute imbalance between cost level and capacity level (mismatch indicator).
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures cars that are overpriced relative to their utility; smooth continuous deviation feature.

features.name: practical_usability_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall practical usability based on whether the car has sufficient safety, capacity, and reasonable cost; encoded as a continuous suitability score where higher means more practically usable for general consumers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a domain-informed smoothed suitability signal that complements raw attributes for linear SVM margins.
